prompt:
Background art for a modern independent 2D side-view adventure platformer in high-resolution "hi-bit" pixel art, made for a game engine with dynamic 2D lighting. The native game screen is 640 pixels wide: the whole picture is built from small crisp square art pixels of one size on one regular grid (each art pixel a small square block of about 2.4 by 2.4 image pixels), as if the game screen were enlarged without smoothing; no anti-aliasing between clusters, no blur, no mixed pixel sizes, no soft airbrushed gradients, no painterly brush texture. Rich but controlled palette of about 80 colours with hue-shifted colour ramps: every material has 4 to 6 shades placed as clean hand-pixelled clusters, shadows shift towards blue-violet, light tones towards warm peach. Careful texture work: individual stones in the cottage wall and the quay slabs, plank lines in the wood, rounded staves and iron hoops on the barrels, cracks and moss on the rocks, all readable as clear pixel clusters. Selective outlines: dark coloured outlines (deep indigo and plum, never pure black) only around the foreground objects, the distant layers have no outlines. Strong atmospheric depth in clear layers: the far hills, the headland and the lighthouse are lighter, bluer and lower in contrast, as if seen through sea haze; the middle distance with the boats is in between; the foreground quay, cottage and props are the most saturated and detailed.

Lighting: soft, even twilight ambient light from the sky, values in the middle range and fully readable (the game engine darkens the scene and adds all light sources itself). Do NOT paint any light sources: no pools of light on the ground, no glow, no halos, no light rays, no cast light from the window or the lantern, no bright reflections in the water. The cottage window and the lantern glass are plain flat warm-yellow shapes; the lighthouse lamp is only a small plain pale-yellow spot without any beam or rays; no smoke from the chimney (lights, the lighthouse beam, reflections and smoke are animated separately in the game). Sky in smooth stepped horizontal bands with sparse ordered dithering between the bands, from deep indigo at the top through violet and dusky rose to a narrow band of orange at the horizon; a few low flat-shaded clouds; a few single-pixel stars in the upper sky. The sea is calm, drawn with horizontal pixel streaks and short light dashes in deep blue and violet that mirror the sky colours.

Side view with a fixed camera at standing eye level, like one screen of a 2D side-scrolling game. The camera is fairly close: the harbour-master's cottage stands on the left edge (partly cut off by the left image border), large, its door about one third of the image height. Wide landscape composition; keep all important things inside the middle 86% of the image height (the top and bottom 7% may be cropped). The horizon lies at about 45% of the image height. The flat walkable top surface of the quay (large stone slabs) is a wide horizontal band from about 63% to 77% of the image height across the whole width, seen slightly from above; below it the front edge of the quay with large stone blocks and dark water, kept simple (a dialogue box will cover it). The iron lantern on its wooden post stands on the quay a little to the right of the cottage, the two barrels, the stack of crates and the coil of rope stand along the back edge of the quay near the cottage; the middle and right part of the quay surface stays free for the characters to walk. The short wooden jetty leads from the back edge of the quay into the water in the middle of the picture, the two small fishing boats are moored beside it in the middle distance. On the right, further away, the rocky headland with the white lighthouse with one red band, its top at about 15% of the image height. Readable silhouettes, few big objects, friendly slightly stylised shapes. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a painting, not a retro low-resolution 8-bit or 16-bit picture, no lens flare, no bloom, no blurry gradients.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Character sprite sheet for a modern independent 2D side-view adventure platformer in high-resolution "hi-bit" pixel art. The first reference image is a pose sheet rendered from a 3D model: copy its layout exactly, with the same 8 walking frames in the top row and the same 4 standing frames in the bottom row, at the same positions and the same scale, with the same body pose and the same leg positions in every frame. The second reference shows the costume and the proportions of the character: take only the costume, the colours of the clothes and the proportions from it; drawing style, resolution and palette follow this description. Each figure is about 64 art pixels tall, every art pixel a crisp square block of the same size on one regular grid (about 4 by 4 image pixels), as if a small game sprite were enlarged without smoothing; no anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft gradients, no texture noise, no glow. Modern pixel-art technique: hue-shifted colour ramps of 4 to 5 shades per material (the greens shift towards teal in the shadows and towards yellow-green in the highlights, the red scarf towards crimson in the shadows and warm orange-red in the highlights, the fur from deep blue-grey to warm grey), clean form shading with the light from the upper left, a one-pixel dark coloured outline (deep plum, not pure black) around the whole figure, selective lighter outline pixels on the lit side. A readable face: the broad white stripe from the nose over the forehead, the dark stripe through the eye, one shiny dark eye with a one-pixel highlight, a black nose tip at the end of the pointed snout, a small smile. About 32 colours in total. Side view facing right.

Layout: Top row: 8 frames of a smooth walk cycle walking to the right that follow the leg positions of the pose sheet (left heel touches down, weight down, legs passing, up, right heel touches down, weight down, legs passing, up); the body bobs slightly, the free arm swings opposite to the legs, the back end of the scarf flutters behind, the parcel stays under the near arm in every frame. Bottom row: 4 frames standing still facing right with the feet as in the pose sheet: 1 standing relaxed, mouth closed, eye open; 2 the same pose with the eye closed (blink); 3 talking, mouth open, the free paw raised in a small gesture; 4 talking, mouth half open, the paw lower. All 12 figures at exactly the same scale, evenly spaced with clear empty space between them, the feet of each row on one baseline.

The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.

Isolated on a fully transparent background, no ground, no shadows, no glow, no frame borders, no grid lines. No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Technical layer mask for a 2D game engine: exactly the attached pixel-art harbour picture, as if traced on a clear sheet laid on top of it, same size, same framing, every object at exactly the same position and with exactly the same outline, nothing moved, nothing added, nothing redrawn. Paint three kinds of areas in flat pure colours, everything else stays exactly as it is in the original, pixel for pixel, with its original colours:
1. The whole sky, including the clouds, the stars, the orange horizon band and the small grey chimney smoke: one flat pure magenta #FF00FF.
2. All open water, both the sea in the distance and the water strip at the bottom in front of the quay wall, including all coloured reflections and light dashes on the water: one flat pure cyan #00FFFF.
3. Everything far away: the distant hills and the far shore with its small houses, the small rocky islets in the sea, and the whole rocky headland on the right with the lighthouse, the keeper's house and the trees: one flat pure yellow #FFFF00.
Keep every near object exactly as it is in the original, with its original colours: the cottage with roof, chimney, window, door, drainpipe and steps, the plants, the lobster pot, the barrels, the crates, the rope coil, the lantern with its post, the quay paving, the stone front wall of the quay, the wooden posts, the bollards, the wooden jetty with all its posts and ropes, and both boats including masts, rigging lines and fenders. Hard pixel edges between the flat colours and the objects, no anti-aliasing, no outline, no glow, no shadow on the flat colours.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
